items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: NavigationMenu
items.description: Top navigation on Base UI NavigationMenu: triggers open content panels in one shared popup that morphs between panel sizes and positions (Viewport, popup size variables). Links render NavLink through render for client-side routing and aria-current.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with Square Enix or PlatinumGames. Compose NavigationMenu > NavigationMenuList > NavigationMenuItem > NavigationMenuTrigger + NavigationMenuContent, or an Item with a NavigationMenuLink. The shared popup (Portal, Positioner, Popup, Arrow, Viewport) is rendered by NavigationMenu; pass viewport={false} to place NavigationMenuViewport yourself. Use render={<NavLink to=... />} on NavigationMenuLink (install @yorha/nav-link). Reduced motion: no morph or slide.
